LanguageData.ZZOP_Enabled: Bullets can keep flying after a hit
LanguageData.ZZOP_MaxPasses: Most pawns, walls or trees one bullet can pass through: {0}
LanguageData.ZZOP_MinResidual: Penetration needed after the exit: {0} mm RHA
LanguageData.ZZOP_MinResidualDesc: A bullet only keeps flying if at least this much penetration is left once it is out of the body, wall or tree.
LanguageData.ZZOP_ThicknessDesc: How much the body itself slows a bullet down. Higher values mean fewer bullets pass through. Thicker body parts and bigger creatures count more.
LanguageData.ZZOP_ExitArmor: Armor counts again on the way out
LanguageData.ZZOP_ExitArmorDesc: A vest has a front and a back. With this on, the armor on the hit body part has to be penetrated twice.
LanguageData.ZZOP_Walls: Bullets can pass through walls, cover and trees
LanguageData.ZZOP_WallsDesc: Walls, doors, barricades, sandbags and trees stop a bullet only if they are strong enough. Wood lets a lot through, steel little, stone and plasteel hardly anything. Natural rock, indestructible buildings and buildings without a material, like most machines, always stop bullets. Curtains let almost everything through. Your own people behind your own walls can get hit too.
LanguageData.ZZOP_WallStrengthDesc: Higher values mean fewer bullets go through walls, cover and trees.
LanguageData.ZZOP_DamagedWallsDesc: A wall at half its hit points stops a bullet like a wall about two thirds as strong.
LanguageData.ZZOP_BlindFireDesc: Chance that an enemy fires one burst through a door or a thin wall like wood when it loses sight of someone it was just fighting. Never through stone or steel walls. Its ammo also has to be able to get through. After that it waits a while before it can do it again. Your own pawns never do this on their own. 0% turns it off.
LanguageData.ZZOP_DebugLog: Write each hit to the log
LanguageData.ZZOP_DebugLogDesc: For testing. Every bullet that is allowed to pass through and hits a pawn, wall or tree writes one line to the log with the numbers behind it and whether it went through.
